scope: scripted P0 diagnostic results; A structured reference model when explicitly enabled; not real human validation

dataset_provenance.source_scope: B-reviewed scripted P0, not real human behavior
dataset_provenance.semantic_mapping: typed message content; access and understanding kept separate
known_limits: nested observer graph is not presumed person knowledge
A/C human blind review not completed

A1.limitations: Finite exact reference; no neural text encoder, P1, LLM, MENTIS or calibrated probabilities. A factor uses latest salient event, not B key-event gold. A2 is coupling removal, not independent BCQ.

training.pair_scope: identical input views and same reference priors; no inferred hidden-world pairs

t1.decision_rule: predictor hard labels; not replaced using p_resume

probability.auprc_definition: non-interpolated average precision; equal scores grouped
probability.ece_definition: positive-class probability ECE with fixed equal-width bins

t2.scope: gold_resume_with_identifiable_gold_step; missing predictions count as incorrect
t2.top3_scope: all_T2_eligible; missing distribution counts as incorrect; null if none available
t2.top1_source: explicit resume_step; not unconditional joint probability
